items.title: Malaysia Says Too Early to See Impact of US Chip Curbs
items.title_ko: Malaysia Says Too Early to See Impact of US Chip Curbs
items.summary_ko: Malaysian Investment Development Authority Chairman, and Senior Political Advisor to the Malaysian Prime Minister, Zafrul Aziz, believes it's too early to see the impact of US chip curbs. The US recently announced it would enforce tighter control on the exports of advanced artificial intelligence chips to Singapore, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia and Brazil.
